audit.framework_rationale: The core state evolution is performed with tensorcircuit.Circuit, including application of the custom one- and two-qubit filters and wavefunction extraction. TensorCircuit is also used to construct the Hamiltonian. JAX supplies differentiable numerical operations, automatic differentiation, JIT compilation, and optimization control, but it is not another quantum framework and does not replace TensorCircuit with an end-to-end simulator.
audit.cheating_rationale: The source contains no hardcoded learned parameters or energy history, hidden-answer access, test or reward manipulation, evaluator tampering, or exploitation of the passing checks. The reported quantities are produced by the declared variational training computation.
audit.fidelity_rationale: The implementation starts from the 18-qubit plus state, constructs the specified open-boundary transverse-field Ising Hamiltonian, applies ten shared-parameter cooling layers with the correct even/odd brickwork bonds, normalizes after every layer, and differentiates through those normalizations. It initializes all filter strengths from the configuration, performs the configured number of standard Adam updates without early stopping, records each loss before its update, and returns the required NumPy arrays with the specified layouts.
audit.implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation error is present. The exponential filter matrices correctly represent exp(a X) and exp(b Z⊗Z), parameter indexing and reshaping match the five-by-two block layout, normalization remains in the differentiable JAX computation, and the successful evaluation metrics are consistent with the implemented algorithm.
